I am definitely a jack of many trades, master of none, as I have taken classes in and use impact, rope, needles/sharps, and fire play, among others. I have attended a wide variety of classes, labs, parties, and performances at Sanctuary and Studio Friction (both arevenues in Denver) starting in 2022. 
I have been focusing my attention on rope more recently. I began exploring shibari in 2023, did my first self suspension in February 2024, and have been suspending others since November 2024. I completed the rope suspension curriculum series at Studio Friction in Denver from November 2024 to May 2025. I have dipped my toes into TAing for curriculum classes there, and hope to eventually become a rope instructor. I also attended a workshop on TKs at Box Tie Studio in Portland, ME in July 2025, as well as a few labs and parties there this summer.
Now that I am suspending regularly and am traveling on the east coast, I am looking to visit new venues and broaden my rope knowledge base outside of what my home studio regularly teaches. I also have not been tying much this summer since I have been away from Denver, and need some time in rope! 
I am also curious to explore ways that other venues manage both physical and emotional safety risks.
